result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the purchase order, shown in the list, and read by the reminder job, the late search, the dashboard on-time figure and the grouping windows.

edge_cases.case: Every line is a display line.
edge_cases.outcome: No line qualifies and the header arrival is empty.

edge_cases.case: A line's arrival is cleared.
edge_cases.outcome: The header arrival is recomputed over the remaining lines and may move later.

edge_cases.case: The header arrival is written directly on the form.
edge_cases.outcome: Every non-display line receives that same value, and the recomputation from the lines is prevented from flowing back down, so the header keeps the typed value.

edge_cases.case: The order has no expected arrival.
edge_cases.outcome: No reminder is ever sent for it.

worked_examples.description: A header over two lines arriving on the 7th and the 13th
worked_examples.narrative: The earliest of the two line arrivals is the 7th at 09:15, and that is the order's expected arrival.

records.name: The midday conversion of an arrival date typed on the portal
records.purpose: Turns a calendar date typed by a vendor on the portal into a stored timestamp that lands on the intended day in every reasonable time zone.

operands.name: date typed by the vendor
operands.source: the portal form the vendor fills in
operands.constraints: a date with no time of day

operands.name: time zone of the order
operands.source: the buyer's time zone, failing that the company partner's, failing that coordinated universal time
operands.constraints: must resolve to one of the three

preconditions.condition: The vendor typed a date.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is stored and the line keeps its previous expected arrival.

preconditions.condition: The line's goods movements are not all done.
preconditions.otherwise: The line's own expected arrival is not changed, and the activity note says the dates could not be modified on the already validated receipt.

procedure: Resolve the order's time zone: the buyer's, failing that the company partner's, failing that coordinated universal time.
Combine the typed date with a time of day of 12:00:00, that is midday.
Interpret that combination as a local time in the resolved time zone.
Convert it to coordinated universal time and store the result as the line's expected arrival.
records.formula: new_timestamp = to_coordinated_universal_time( localise( combine( typed_date , 12:00:00 ) , order_time_zone ) )

rounding.what: Nothing: the result is a timestamp.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.method: Not applicable; midday is chosen so that no reasonable offset moves the stored value onto a neighbouring calendar day.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.name: expected arrival of the line
result.unit_or_currency: a timestamp in coordinated universal time
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the order line, and reflected in the order's header arrival.

edge_cases.case: The buyer has no time zone.
edge_cases.outcome: The company partner's time zone is used; failing that, coordinated universal time, in which case the stored value is the typed date at 12:00.

edge_cases.case: The time zone is many hours ahead of coordinated universal time.
edge_cases.outcome: The stored timestamp falls on the morning of the same calendar day or on the late evening of the previous one, but midday leaves enough margin that the intended day is preserved for every ordinary offset.

edge_cases.case: The vendor types a date already in the past.
edge_cases.outcome: It is stored unchanged; the portal applies no lower bound to the typed date.

worked_examples.description: A buyer five hours behind coordinated universal time
worked_examples.narrative: Midday on the 14th in a zone five hours behind coordinated universal time is 17:00 on the 14th in coordinated universal time, so the stored value stays on the intended calendar day.

records.name: Received quantity of a line whose method is goods movements
records.purpose: Gives the quantity a line counts as received when the received quantity is derived from completed goods movements, which is the ordinary case whenever inventory is installed.

operands.name: completed goods movements of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of each movement
operands.source: the movements linked to the order line whose product equals the line's product and whose status is done
operands.constraints: restricted to those dated on or before the accrual date when one is supplied

operands.name: unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the unit field of the order line
operands.constraints: must belong to the category of the product reference unit

operands.name: accrual date
operands.source: supplied by the accrued-expense computation, otherwise absent
operands.constraints: when absent, every completed movement counts

preconditions.condition: The line's received-quantity method is goods movements.
preconditions.otherwise: The manual variant or the kit variant applies instead.

preconditions.condition: The line has a product.
preconditions.otherwise: No movement can match and the received quantity is zero.

preconditions.condition: The line is not a display line.
preconditions.otherwise: The received quantity is zero.

procedure: Collect the completed goods movements of the line whose product equals the line's product.
When an accrual date is supplied, drop the movements dated after it.
Compute the contribution of each remaining movement, which is a signed quantity converted into the line's unit.
Add the contributions together and store the sum as the received quantity of the line.
records.formula: qty_received = Σ over the completed movements m of the line of contribution( m )

rounding.what: Each movement's converted quantity, before it is added to the sum.
rounding.precision: The rounding of the line's unit of measure.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, named explicitly by the conversion so that the target unit's own rounding method is not used.
rounding.step: Once per movement, at the conversion into the line unit; the sum is not rounded again.

result.name: received quantity of the line
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the order line and read by the quantity to bill, by the billing status, by the late search and by the punctuality figures.

edge_cases.case: A line with no completed movement.
edge_cases.outcome: The received quantity is zero.

edge_cases.case: A movement expressed in a different unit of the same category.
edge_cases.outcome: It is converted into the line unit before it is added, rounding half away from zero.

edge_cases.case: A line whose ordered quantity is lowered below the received quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: No movement is removed; the excess simply stays received, and the billing arithmetic may go negative.

edge_cases.case: A full receipt followed by a full refundable return.
edge_cases.outcome: The two contributions cancel and the received quantity returns to zero.

worked_examples.description: Three completed movements against a line ordered in boxes of twelve

movement_c.nature: return to the vendor flagged to be refunded

worked_examples.narrative: Movement A contributes plus seventy-two divided by twelve, that is six boxes; movement B plus two boxes; and movement C, a refundable return, minus one box. The received quantity is six plus two minus one, that is seven boxes.

records.name: The contribution of one completed goods movement to the received quantity
records.purpose: Decides the sign and the size of one movement's contribution, which is where returns, drop shipments and non-countable movements are excluded.

operands.name: quantity of the movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the movement
operands.source: the completed goods movement
operands.constraints: may be zero; a negative movement quantity is judged at the rounding of the movement unit

operands.name: unit of measure of the movement
operands.source: the goods movement
operands.constraints: must belong to the category of the line unit

operands.name: unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the order line
operands.constraints: the target of the conversion

operands.name: nature of the movement
operands.source: whether the movement is a purchase return, whether it has an original movement, whether it is flagged to be refunded, whether it returns a drop-shipped movement, whether it is itself a drop-ship return, and whether it is marked as not counting for received quantities
operands.constraints: each is a yes or no property of the movement

preconditions.condition: The movement is completed.
preconditions.otherwise: It does not enter the set at all and contributes nothing.

preconditions.condition: The movement's product equals the line's product.
preconditions.otherwise: It does not enter the set at all.

procedure: Apply the tests in the order given and stop at the first that matches.
When the movement is a purchase return and it either has no original movement or is flagged to be refunded, contribute minus its quantity converted into the line unit, rounding half away from zero.
Otherwise, when the movement is a purchase return, contribute zero.
Otherwise, when the movement returns a drop-shipped movement and is not itself a drop-ship return, contribute zero.
Otherwise, when the movement returns a purchase return and is not flagged to be refunded, contribute zero.
Otherwise, when the movement is marked as not counting for received quantities, contribute zero.
Otherwise contribute plus its quantity converted into the line unit, rounding half away from zero.
records.formula: contribution( m ) = − convert_quantity( m.quantity , m.unit , line_unit , rounding = half away from zero ) when m is a purchase return and ( m has no original movement or m is flagged to be refunded ) ; = 0 when m is a purchase return otherwise ; = 0 when m returns a drop-shipped movement and m is not itself a drop-ship return ; = 0 when m returns a purchase return and m is not flagged to be refunded ; = 0 when m must not be counted for received quantities ; = + convert_quantity( m.quantity , m.unit , line_unit , rounding = half away from zero ) otherwise

rounding.what: The converted quantity of the movement.
rounding.precision: The rounding of the line's unit of measure.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, named explicitly.
rounding.step: Once, at the conversion, before the sign is applied.

result.name: signed contribution of the movement
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; added into the line's received quantity.

edge_cases.case: A return that carries an original movement and is not flagged to be refunded.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes zero, so the goods leave without reducing the received quantity; the received quantity stays at what was delivered.

edge_cases.case: A return with no original movement.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes negatively whether or not it is flagged to be refunded, because the first test accepts either condition.

edge_cases.case: A return of a drop-shipped movement that is itself a drop-ship return.
edge_cases.outcome: The third test does not match it, so it falls through to the later tests and can contribute.

edge_cases.case: A movement marked as not counting for received quantities.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes zero however it is otherwise classified, provided no earlier test matched first.

edge_cases.case: A movement whose quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes zero whichever branch applies.

worked_examples.description: The same refundable return judged with and without its original movement
worked_examples.narrative: The movement is a purchase return flagged to be refunded, so the first test matches and it contributes minus one box.

worked_examples.description: The same return neither flagged nor lacking an original movement
worked_examples.narrative: The first test fails because the movement has an original movement and is not flagged to be refunded, so the second test matches and the contribution is zero; with the other two movements of six and two boxes the received quantity stays at eight boxes.

records.name: Received quantity of a line whose method is manual
records.purpose: Gives the received quantity of a line whose receipts are typed rather than derived, and fixes what happens to the typed value when the method is not manual.

operands.name: manual received quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the manual received-quantity field of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero; defaults to zero when never typed

operands.name: received-quantity method of the line
operands.source: the method field of the order line, whose manual value is `manual`
operands.constraints: one of the stored method values

preconditions.condition: The line's received-quantity method is manual.
preconditions.otherwise: The goods-movement variant or the kit variant applies instead, and the manual field is forced to zero.

procedure: Take the manual received quantity of the line, treating an empty value as zero.
Store it as the received quantity of the line.
When the received quantity is written directly and the method is manual, write the manual field.

When the received quantity is written directly and the method is not manual, force the manual field to zero, so that a line whose method is not manual always carries a manual quantity of exactly zero.
records.formula: qty_received = qty_received_manual , treating an empty value as 0

rounding.what: Nothing beyond the ordinary quantity precision.
rounding.precision: The Product Unit decimal precision, or the rounding of the line unit where a comparison names it.
rounding.step: When the typed figure is stored.

result.name: received quantity of the line
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the order line, exactly as on a line whose method is goods movements.

edge_cases.case: The method is changed away from manual.
edge_cases.outcome: The manual field is forced to zero, in keeping with the invariant that a line whose method is not manual has a manual received quantity of exactly zero.

edge_cases.case: The manual quantity has never been typed.
edge_cases.outcome: It is treated as zero.

edge_cases.case: A manual quantity above the ordered quantity is typed.
edge_cases.outcome: It is accepted; the quantity to bill under the received-quantities policy then exceeds the ordered quantity.

edge_cases.case: A negative manual quantity is typed.
edge_cases.outcome: It is accepted and the billing arithmetic follows the sign.

worked_examples.description: A line whose receipts are typed
worked_examples.narrative: The typed value of six is the received quantity, with no movement consulted at all.

worked_examples.description: The same line switched to the goods-movement method
worked_examples.narrative: Writing the received quantity while the method is not manual forces the manual field to zero, so the typed six is discarded.

records.name: Received quantity of a line whose product is a kit
records.purpose: Gives the received quantity of a line whose product resolves to a kit, which is the number of complete kits the received components allow, not the number of components received.

operands.name: total quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the ordered quantity of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: unit of measure of the kit
operands.source: the kit structure resolved for the line's company
operands.constraints: must belong to the category of the line unit

operands.name: required quantity of each component per kit
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of each component
operands.source: the exploded kit structure
operands.constraints: strictly positive for a component that counts

operands.name: net received quantity of each component
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of each component
operands.source: the completed goods movements of the line that are not inventory adjustments
operands.constraints: incoming quantities count positively, a return of an incoming movement counts only when flagged to be refunded, and outgoing quantities flagged to be refunded count negatively

preconditions.condition: The line's product resolves to a kit structure in the line's company.
preconditions.otherwise: The ordinary goods-movement variant applies instead and the received quantity is the sum of the movement contributions.

preconditions.condition: At least one component has a strictly positive required quantity per kit.
preconditions.otherwise: No ratio can be formed and the received quantity is zero.

preconditions.condition: The component quantity used to value a bill line is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The cost-recognition entries cannot be produced and the operation is refused with "The system is not able to generate the anglo saxon entries. The total valuation of the product name is zero.", where the product name is the name of the product; the shipped text opens with the application's own name, rendered here as "The system".

procedure: Convert the line's total quantity from the line unit into the kit's unit.
Explode the kit for that quantity, obtaining for each component the required quantity per kit.

From the line's completed goods movements that are not inventory adjustments, compute for each component its net received quantity: add incoming quantities, count a return of an incoming movement only when it is flagged to be refunded, subtract outgoing quantities that are flagged to be refunded, and express everything in the component's reference unit.
Divide each component's net received quantity by its required quantity per kit.
Take the smallest of those ratios, which is the number of complete kits obtainable.
Convert that number back into the line's unit and store it as the received quantity.
records.formula: qty_received_in_kits = min over the components c of ( net_received( c ) ÷ required_per_kit( c ) ) , then converted back into the line unit

rounding.what: The converted quantities and the final kit count.
rounding.precision: The rounding of the component's reference unit for the net received quantities, and the rounding of the line unit for the final conversion.
rounding.step: At each conversion; the ratios themselves are not rounded before the smallest is taken.

result.name: received quantity of the line, counted in kits
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the order line and used by the quantity to bill and by the valuation of the bill line.

edge_cases.case: One component is short.
edge_cases.outcome: The smallest ratio is that component's, so the whole kit count is held back until it arrives; the remaining components are received but do not count.

edge_cases.case: A component arrives in excess.
edge_cases.outcome: Its ratio is higher and does not raise the kit count, because the smallest ratio governs.

edge_cases.case: A component movement is an inventory adjustment.
edge_cases.outcome: It is excluded from the net received quantity, so a stock correction never creates a received kit.

edge_cases.case: A return of a component that is not flagged to be refunded.
edge_cases.outcome: It does not reduce the net received quantity.

edge_cases.case: The number of complete kits is zero and a bill is being valued.
edge_cases.outcome: The cost-recognition entries cannot be produced and the operation is refused with the message named in the preconditions.

worked_examples.description: A kit of one desk and two drawers, five kits ordered
worked_examples.narrative: The desk ratio is five divided by one, that is five; the drawer ratio is eight divided by two, that is four. The smallest is four, so four complete kits are received and the fifth becomes receivable only when two more drawers arrive.

records.name: The value of a kit component scaled by its cost share
records.purpose: Splits the value a bill line carries across the component movements of a kit, in proportion to each component's cost share.

operands.name: value of the bill line
operands.source: the subtotal the bill line carries for the kit
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: cost share of the component
operands.source: the component line of the kit structure
operands.constraints: either every component's share is zero, or the shares total exactly 100

preconditions.condition: The cost shares of the kit's components are either all zero or total exactly 100.
preconditions.otherwise: The kit is misconfigured; the domain compares the shares with zero and the set with one hundred at two digits and refuses a set that satisfies neither.

preconditions.condition: The bill line carries a value.
preconditions.otherwise: There is nothing to split and every component value is zero.

procedure: Take the value the bill line carries for the kit.
Divide the component's cost share by one hundred.
Multiply the bill line value by that fraction to obtain the component's share of the value.
Repeat for every component; the shares total one hundred per cent, so the component values add back to the bill line value.
records.formula: component_value = bill_line_value × ( cost_share ÷ 100 )

rounding.what: The component value when it is written into the valuation.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the company currency.
rounding.step: Once, when the component value is written; the fraction is not rounded.

result.name: value attributed to the component movement
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Written onto the valuation of the component's goods movement.

edge_cases.case: Every component share is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Each component takes an equal share, that is one divided by the number of components, so a kit of four components gives each a quarter.

edge_cases.case: The shares do not total one hundred and are not all zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The configuration is refused by the cost-share validation.

edge_cases.case: The bill line is a refund.
edge_cases.outcome: The value is negative and each component's share is negative in the same proportion.

worked_examples.description: A kit bought for three hundred with shares of seventy and thirty per cent
worked_examples.narrative: Three hundred multiplied by 0.70 is 210.00 for the desk movements and three hundred multiplied by 0.30 is 90.00 for the drawer movements; the two add back to the bill line value of 300.00.

records.name: The cost ratio of a partly valued kit component movement
records.purpose: Gives the fraction of a bill line's value that one component movement takes when only part of the component quantity is being valued.

operands.name: cost share of the component
operands.source: the component line of the kit structure
operands.constraints: either zero for every component or totalling exactly 100

operands.name: quantity being valued
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of the component
operands.source: the part of the component movement being valued
operands.constraints: may be smaller than the component's whole quantity

operands.name: component quantity expressed in the product reference unit
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of the component
operands.source: the component movement
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: total active quantity of the sibling movements sharing the same kit line and cost share
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of the component
operands.source: the sibling component movements
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: purchased quantity in the product reference unit
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of the product
operands.source: the purchase order line
operands.constraints: strictly positive

preconditions.condition: The component quantity in the product reference unit is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The ratio is undefined and no value can be attributed to the movement.

preconditions.condition: The sibling movements have a non-zero total active quantity.
preconditions.otherwise: The share of the purchased kit quantity attributable to this movement is undefined and no value can be attributed.

procedure: Divide the component's cost share by one hundred.
Divide the quantity being valued by the component quantity expressed in the product reference unit, giving the fraction of the component movement being valued.

Compute the share of the purchased kit quantity attributable to this movement: divide the movement's quantity by the total active quantity of the sibling movements that share the same kit line and cost share, then multiply by the purchased quantity in the product reference unit.
Multiply the three factors together to obtain the cost ratio.
records.formula: cost_ratio = ( cost_share ÷ 100 ) × ( quantity ÷ component_quantity_in_product_unit ) × unit_kit_purchase , where unit_kit_purchase = ( quantity of this movement ÷ total active quantity of the sibling movements sharing the same kit line and cost share ) × purchased quantity in the product reference unit

rounding.what: The value obtained by applying the ratio.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the company currency.
rounding.step: Once, when the resulting value is written; the ratio itself is not rounded.

result.name: cost ratio of the component movement
result.unit_or_currency: a ratio
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; multiplied by the bill line value to obtain the value attributed to the movement.

edge_cases.case: The whole component quantity is being valued.
edge_cases.outcome: The second factor is one and the ratio reduces to the cost share fraction multiplied by the share of the purchased kit quantity.

edge_cases.case: Only one sibling movement exists.
edge_cases.outcome: Its share of the purchased kit quantity is the whole purchased quantity.

edge_cases.case: Every component share is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The equal share of one divided by the number of components is used in place of the cost share fraction.

worked_examples.description: Half of a component movement valued for a kit whose component share is seventy per cent
worked_examples.narrative: The cost share fraction is 0.7, half the component movement is being valued so the second factor is 0.5, and the share of the purchased kit quantity is one; the product is 0.35, so the movement takes thirty-five per cent of the bill line value.

records.name: The equal cost share when every component share is zero
records.purpose: Fixes what a kit's components take when no cost share has been configured, so that a bill line's value is still split deterministically.

operands.name: number of components of the kit
operands.source: the kit structure resolved for the company
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: cost share of each component
operands.source: the component lines of the kit structure
operands.constraints: every one of them is zero in this variant

preconditions.condition: Every component's cost share is zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The configured shares are used instead and must total exactly one hundred, compared at two digits.

preconditions.condition: The kit has at least one component.
preconditions.otherwise: No split can be made and no value is attributed.

procedure: Verify that every component's cost share is zero, comparing each with zero at two digits.
Divide one by the number of components to obtain the equal share of each.
Apply that equal share in place of the cost share fraction wherever a component value or a cost ratio is computed.
records.formula: equal_cost_share = 1 ÷ number_of_components , applied in place of ( cost_share ÷ 100 ) when every component share is zero

rounding.what: The value obtained by applying the equal share.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the company currency.
rounding.step: Once, when the component value is written; the equal share itself is not rounded.

result.name: equal cost share of each component
result.unit_or_currency: a fraction
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; used in place of the configured cost share fraction.

edge_cases.case: The shares are neither all zero nor totalling one hundred.
edge_cases.outcome: The configuration is refused: the domain requires one of the two.

edge_cases.case: A kit of one component.
edge_cases.outcome: The equal share is one and that component takes the whole value.

edge_cases.case: A kit of three components.
edge_cases.outcome: Each takes one third, and the three values add back to the bill line value up to the currency rounding.

worked_examples.description: A kit of four components with no configured share
worked_examples.narrative: One divided by four is 0.25, so each of the four components takes seventy-five of the three hundred.

records.name: Billed quantity of a line
records.purpose: Gives the quantity of a line that vendor bills have already covered, netting refunds against bills, which the quantity still to bill subtracts from.

operands.name: quantity of each bill line linked to the order line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the bill line
operands.source: the bill lines that point at the purchase order line
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: unit of measure of each bill line
operands.source: the bill line
operands.constraints: must belong to the category of the order line's unit

operands.name: unit of measure of the order line
operands.source: the order line
operands.constraints: the target of the conversion

operands.name: document type of each bill line's document
operands.source: the document holding the bill line
operands.constraints: either a vendor bill or a vendor refund

operands.name: status of each bill line's document
operands.source: the document holding the bill line
operands.constraints: a cancelled document is skipped unless its payment state marks it as historically invoiced

preconditions.condition: The bill line points at the purchase order line.
preconditions.otherwise: It is not counted at all; only linked bill lines contribute.

preconditions.condition: The bill line's document is not cancelled.
preconditions.otherwise: It is skipped, unless the document's payment state marks it as historically invoiced, in which case it is counted.

procedure: Collect the bill lines that point at the order line.
Skip a bill line whose document is cancelled, unless the document's payment state marks it as historically invoiced.
Give each remaining bill line a sign: plus one when its document is a vendor bill, minus one when its document is a vendor refund.
Convert each bill line's quantity from its own unit into the order line's unit.
Multiply each converted quantity by its sign and add the results together.
records.formula: qty_invoiced = Σ over the bill lines b of sign( b ) × convert_quantity( b.quantity , b.unit , line_unit ) , with sign( b ) = +1 when b's document is a vendor bill and −1 when it is a vendor refund

rounding.what: Each converted quantity, before it is signed and added.
rounding.precision: The rounding of the order line's unit of measure.
rounding.step: Once per bill line, at the conversion; the sum is not rounded again.

result.name: billed quantity of the line
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the order line
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the order line and read by the quantity still to bill, by the billing status and by the analysis figures.

edge_cases.case: A bill line on a cancelled document.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped, unless the document's payment state marks it as historically invoiced.

edge_cases.case: A bill and a refund of the same quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: They cancel and the billed quantity returns to zero.

edge_cases.case: A bill line expressed in a different unit of the same category.
edge_cases.outcome: It is converted into the order line's unit before it is counted.

edge_cases.case: A bill is deleted after its posting was reversed.
edge_cases.outcome: The order's bill list recomputes and the billing status may fall back from the invoiced status to the nothing-to-bill status.

worked_examples.description: Six units billed and two of them refunded
worked_examples.narrative: The bill line counts plus six and the refund line minus two, so the billed quantity is four.

records.name: Quantity to bill under the ordered-quantities control policy
records.purpose: Gives the quantity a line still has to be billed for when the product's bill control policy is the ordered-quantities policy, so that the vendor may bill the whole order as soon as it is confirmed.

operands.name: ordered quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the total quantity field of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: billed quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the computed billed quantity of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: status of the order
operands.source: the status field of the order, whose confirmed value is `purchase`
operands.constraints: the quantity to bill is zero in every other status

operands.name: bill control policy of the product
operands.source: the product setting, whose stored value for this policy is `purchase` (bill on ordered quantities)
operands.constraints: one of the two stored policy values

preconditions.condition: The order's status is the confirmed status.
preconditions.otherwise: The quantity to bill is exactly zero, in keeping with the invariant that an order not in the confirmed status has a quantity to bill of zero on every line.

preconditions.condition: The product's bill control policy is the ordered-quantities policy.
preconditions.otherwise: The received-quantities variant applies instead.

preconditions.condition: The line is not a display line.
preconditions.otherwise: The quantity to bill is zero.

procedure: Check the order's status; return zero unless it is the confirmed status.
Take the line's ordered quantity.
Subtract the line's billed quantity.
Store the difference as the quantity still to bill; it may be negative when more has been billed than was ordered.
records.formula: qty_to_invoice = 0 when order.state ≠ `purchase` ; = product_qty − qty_invoiced when the product's bill control policy is `purchase`

rounding.what: The difference when it is compared with zero.
rounding.precision: The Product Unit decimal precision for the zero test, and the rounding of the line unit for the comparison of the ordered quantity with the billed quantity.
rounding.step: At the comparison; the stored difference itself is a quantity written at the Product Unit precision.

result.name: quantity still to bill
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the order line, shown on the order form, and used to build the lines of a generated vendor bill.

edge_cases.case: The order is not in the confirmed status.
edge_cases.outcome: The quantity to bill is exactly zero whatever the ordered and billed quantities are.

edge_cases.case: More has been billed than was ordered.
edge_cases.outcome: The quantity to bill is negative and a generated document becomes a vendor refund.

edge_cases.case: The ordered quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The quantity to bill is minus the billed quantity.

edge_cases.case: Every line has nothing to bill and no bill exists.
edge_cases.outcome: The order's billing status is the nothing-to-bill status, not the invoiced status.

worked_examples.description: Ten ordered, six billed, under the ordered-quantities policy
worked_examples.narrative: Ten ordered minus six billed leaves four still to bill, whatever has been received.

records.name: Quantity to bill under the received-quantities control policy
records.purpose: Gives the quantity a line still has to be billed for when the product's bill control policy is the received-quantities policy, so that the vendor may bill only what has arrived.

operands.name: received quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the computed received quantity of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: billed quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the computed billed quantity of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: status of the order
operands.source: the status field of the order, whose confirmed value is `purchase`
operands.constraints: the quantity to bill is zero in every other status

operands.name: bill control policy of the product
operands.source: the product setting, whose stored value for this policy is `receive` (bill on received quantities)
operands.constraints: one of the two stored policy values

preconditions.condition: The order's status is the confirmed status.
preconditions.otherwise: The quantity to bill is exactly zero.

preconditions.condition: The product's bill control policy is the received-quantities policy.
preconditions.otherwise: The ordered-quantities variant applies instead.

preconditions.condition: The line is not a display line.
preconditions.otherwise: The quantity to bill is zero.

procedure: Check the order's status; return zero unless it is the confirmed status.
Take the line's received quantity.
Subtract the line's billed quantity.
Store the difference as the quantity still to bill; it may be negative after a refundable return, and that negative figure is what produces a vendor refund.
records.formula: qty_to_invoice = 0 when order.state ≠ `purchase` ; = qty_received − qty_invoiced when the product's bill control policy is `receive`

rounding.what: The difference when it is compared with zero.
rounding.precision: The Product Unit decimal precision for the zero test.
rounding.step: At the comparison; the stored difference itself is a quantity written at the Product Unit precision.

result.name: quantity still to bill
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the order line and used to build the lines of a generated vendor bill or refund.

edge_cases.case: Nothing has been received yet.
edge_cases.outcome: The quantity to bill is minus the billed quantity, which is zero on a line that has not been billed either.

edge_cases.case: Goods are returned and the return is flagged to be refunded.
edge_cases.outcome: The received quantity falls, the quantity to bill goes negative, and that negative figure is what produces a vendor refund.

edge_cases.case: A line's ordered quantity is lowered below the received quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The received quantity is unchanged and the quantity to bill still reflects what arrived.

edge_cases.case: The order is not in the confirmed status.
edge_cases.outcome: The quantity to bill is exactly zero.

worked_examples.description: Six received, none billed, under the received-quantities policy
worked_examples.narrative: Six received minus nothing billed leaves six still to bill.

worked_examples.description: Two units returned after everything had been billed
worked_examples.narrative: Eight received minus ten billed is minus two, and that negative quantity is what a vendor refund is built from.

records.name: The progression of received, billed and to-bill quantities over a line's life
records.purpose: Shows the two bill control policies side by side over the whole life of one line, so that a rebuild can be tested against the sequence rather than against a single moment.

operands.name: ordered quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the order line
operands.constraints: ten units in the worked example

operands.name: unit price of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the order currency per line unit
operands.source: the order line
operands.constraints: sixty in the worked example

operands.name: received quantity after each event
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the computed received quantity
operands.constraints: changes as goods arrive and as refundable returns leave

operands.name: billed quantity after each event
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the computed billed quantity
operands.constraints: changes as bills and refunds are posted

preconditions.condition: The order is in the confirmed status throughout.
preconditions.otherwise: Every quantity to bill is zero, under either policy.

preconditions.condition: Returns are flagged to be refunded.
preconditions.otherwise: A return that is not flagged contributes nothing and the received quantity does not fall.

procedure: After each event, recompute the received quantity from the completed goods movements and the billed quantity from the linked bill lines.
Under the ordered-quantities policy, subtract the billed quantity from the ordered quantity.
Under the received-quantities policy, subtract the billed quantity from the received quantity.
Compare each result with zero at the Product Unit precision to decide whether the line still has anything to bill.
records.formula: under the ordered-quantities policy : qty_to_invoice = product_qty − qty_invoiced ; under the received-quantities policy : qty_to_invoice = qty_received − qty_invoiced

rounding.what: Each quantity as it is written.
rounding.precision: The Product Unit decimal precision.
rounding.step: At each recomputation.

result.name: quantity still to bill under each policy
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the order line; only one of the two is stored at a time, according to the product's own policy.

edge_cases.case: The final row, after two units are returned and flagged to be refunded.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the received-quantities policy goes negative, at minus two; the ordered-quantities policy stays at zero.

edge_cases.case: A return that is not flagged to be refunded.
edge_cases.outcome: The received quantity does not fall and neither policy changes.

edge_cases.case: The order is reset to draft.
edge_cases.outcome: Both figures become zero, because the status is no longer the confirmed status.

worked_examples.description: Ten units at sixty, followed through six events
worked_examples.narrative: After confirmation nothing has arrived and nothing has been billed, so the ordered-quantities policy already offers ten to bill while the received-quantities policy offers none. Six arrive, then six are billed, then four more arrive and are billed, and both policies reach zero. Two units are then returned and flagged to be refunded: the received quantity falls to eight while ten remain billed, so the received-quantities policy shows minus two and a vendor refund is due, whereas the ordered-quantities policy stays at zero.

records.name: Quantity still to bill at a date under the ordered-quantities control policy
records.purpose: Gives the quantity a line still had to be billed for as at an accrual date, for a product billed on ordered quantities, which the accrued-expense entry values.

operands.name: ordered quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the total quantity field of the order line
operands.constraints: not restricted by the accrual date, because an order's ordered quantity is not dated

operands.name: billed quantity as at the accrual date
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the billed quantity recomputed over the bill lines dated on or before the accrual date
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: accrual date
operands.source: the date chosen on the accrued-expense assistant
operands.constraints: in the past for the restricted recomputation to apply

preconditions.condition: The product's bill control policy is the ordered-quantities policy.
preconditions.otherwise: The received-quantities variant applies instead.

preconditions.condition: The accrual date is in the past.
preconditions.otherwise: The stored billed quantity is used unchanged, because a date that is today or in the future restricts nothing.

procedure: Recompute the billed quantity over the bill lines dated on or before the accrual date.
Take the line's ordered quantity, which is not restricted by the date.
Subtract the restricted billed quantity from it.
Compare the difference with zero at the rounding of the line unit; a line whose difference is zero is left out of the accrual entry.
records.formula: qty_to_invoice_at_date = product_qty − qty_invoiced_at_date , for a product whose bill control policy is `purchase`

rounding.what: The difference when it is compared with zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding of the line's unit of measure.
rounding.step: At the comparison that decides whether the line enters the accrual entry.

result.name: quantity still to bill as at the accrual date
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the amount still to bill and by the accrued-expense entry.

edge_cases.case: The accrual date is today or later.
edge_cases.outcome: The stored billed quantity is used and the figure equals the ordinary quantity to bill.

edge_cases.case: More had been billed at that date than was ordered.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is negative, and the accrual entry credits the expense account, deferring the over-billed expense to the next period.

edge_cases.case: The line is a display line or a down-payment line.
edge_cases.outcome: It is excluded from the accrual selection altogether.

edge_cases.case: The figure is zero at the line unit's rounding.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is excluded from the accrual entry.

worked_examples.description: Ten ordered and four billed at the accrual date
worked_examples.narrative: Ten ordered minus four billed at that date leaves six still to bill as at the accrual date.

records.name: Quantity still to bill at a date under the received-quantities control policy
records.purpose: Gives the quantity a line still had to be billed for as at an accrual date, for a product billed on received quantities, which is the usual basis of an accrued-expense entry.

operands.name: received quantity as at the accrual date
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the received quantity recomputed over the completed goods movements dated on or before the accrual date
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: billed quantity as at the accrual date
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the billed quantity recomputed over the bill lines dated on or before the accrual date
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: accrual date
operands.source: the date chosen on the accrued-expense assistant
operands.constraints: in the past for the restricted recomputation to apply

preconditions.condition: The product's bill control policy is the received-quantities policy.
preconditions.otherwise: The ordered-quantities variant applies instead.

preconditions.condition: The accrual date is in the past.
preconditions.otherwise: The stored received and billed quantities are used unchanged.

procedure: Recompute the received quantity over the completed goods movements dated on or before the accrual date.
Recompute the billed quantity over the bill lines dated on or before the accrual date.
Subtract the restricted billed quantity from the restricted received quantity.
Compare the difference with zero at the rounding of the line unit; a line whose difference is zero is left out of the accrual entry.
records.formula: qty_to_invoice_at_date = qty_received_at_date − qty_invoiced_at_date , for a product whose bill control policy is `receive`

rounding.what: The difference when it is compared with zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding of the line's unit of measure.
rounding.step: At the comparison that decides whether the line enters the accrual entry.

result.name: quantity still to bill as at the accrual date
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the amount still to bill and by the accrued-expense entry.

edge_cases.case: Goods arrived after the accrual date.
edge_cases.outcome: Their movements are dropped from the restricted set, so they do not raise the received quantity as at that date.

edge_cases.case: The vendor had billed more than had arrived at that date.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is negative and the accrual entry reverses the excess.

edge_cases.case: Nothing had arrived and nothing had been billed.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is zero and the line is excluded from the entry.

edge_cases.case: The accrual date is today or later.
edge_cases.outcome: The stored quantities are used unchanged.

worked_examples.description: Six received and none billed at the accrual date
worked_examples.narrative: Six received at that date minus nothing billed leaves six still to bill as at the accrual date.

worked_examples.description: Six received and eight billed at the accrual date
worked_examples.narrative: Six received minus eight billed is minus two, so the accrual entry defers the over-billed expense rather than recognising it.

records.name: The gross unit price of a line
records.purpose: Builds the price per reference unit of the product that the amount still to bill multiplies by, with the discount applied, the taxes removed and the unit restated, in that order.

operands.name: unit price of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the order currency per line unit
operands.source: the unit price field of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: discount percentage of the line
operands.source: the discount field of the order line
operands.constraints: from 0 to 100 in ordinary use

operands.name: taxes of the line
operands.source: the tax set of the order line
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: ordered quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the total quantity field of the order line
operands.constraints: when it is zero, a quantity of one is used in its place for the tax computation

operands.name: factor of the product reference unit
operands.source: the unit of measure record of the product reference unit
operands.constraints: strictly positive; the factor of a unit is the number of reference units it contains, so the reference unit itself has a factor of one

operands.name: factor of the line unit
operands.source: the unit of measure record of the line unit
operands.constraints: strictly positive; a box of twelve pieces has a factor of twelve when the reference unit is the piece

preconditions.condition: The order carries a currency.
preconditions.otherwise: The company currency is used in its place for the tax computation.

preconditions.condition: The line has an ordered quantity that is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: A quantity of one is used in its place, so that the tax computation and the division that follows it are well defined.

procedure: Start from the line's unit price.
When a discount exists, multiply by one minus the discount divided by one hundred.

When taxes exist, let the quantity be the ordered quantity, or one when it is zero; compute the taxes on that discounted price for that quantity in the order currency with global rounding; take the resulting amount that excludes every tax, including those that are not deductible; and divide it by that quantity.

When the line unit differs from the product reference unit, multiply by the factor of the product reference unit divided by the factor of the line unit, which restates the price from the line unit to the product reference unit.
Carry the result forward without rounding it.
records.formula: gross_price_unit = ( total_excluding_every_tax( price_unit × ( 1 − discount ÷ 100 ) , taxes , q ) ÷ q ) × ( product_unit_factor ÷ line_unit_factor ) , with q = the ordered quantity or 1 when it is zero

rounding.what: The tax computation inside the second step.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the order currency, applied by the tax engine with global rounding.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied once for the whole computation because the rounding is global.
rounding.step: Inside the tax computation only; the division by the quantity and the unit restatement are not rounded.

result.name: gross unit price
result.unit_or_currency: the order currency per reference unit of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; multiplied by the quantity still to bill to give the amount still to bill, and used as the starting figure of the price-difference test at billing time.

edge_cases.case: The line has no tax.
edge_cases.outcome: The second step is skipped and the discounted price passes through unchanged.

edge_cases.case: A tax is fully recoverable and is not included in the price.
edge_cases.outcome: The amount excluding every tax equals the discounted price, so the step leaves the price unchanged.

edge_cases.case: A tax is not deductible.
edge_cases.outcome: It is included in the amount excluding every tax, so the gross unit price rises and the cost carries the non-recoverable tax.

edge_cases.case: The ordered quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: A quantity of one is used for the tax computation and for the division that follows.

edge_cases.case: The line unit is the product reference unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The two factors are equal and the last step leaves the price unchanged.

worked_examples.description: A price of 120.00 per box of twelve with a five per cent discount and a fully recoverable tax of twenty per cent
worked_examples.narrative: The discounted price is 120.00 multiplied by 0.95, that is 114.00 per box. The tax is not included in the price, so the amount excluding every tax is still 114.00 per box. The line unit is the box and the product reference unit is the piece, so multiplying by the ratio of the two factors restates 114.00 per box as 9.50 per unit.

records.name: The amount still to bill at a date
records.purpose: Gives the money value of what a line still has to be billed for as at an accrual date, which is the figure the accrued-expense entry posts.

operands.name: quantity still to bill as at the accrual date
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the at-date quantity computed under the product's bill control policy
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the order line
operands.constraints: the source of the restatement

operands.name: reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: the target of the restatement

operands.name: gross unit price
operands.unit_or_currency: the order currency per reference unit of the product
operands.source: the four-step gross unit price of the line
operands.constraints: may be zero

preconditions.condition: The quantity still to bill at the date is not zero at the line unit's rounding.
preconditions.otherwise: The line is excluded from the accrual entry altogether.

preconditions.condition: The line is neither a display line nor a down-payment line.
preconditions.otherwise: It is excluded from the accrual selection.

procedure: Take the quantity still to bill as at the accrual date, in the line's unit.
Convert it from the line unit into the product reference unit.
Multiply the converted quantity by the gross unit price, which is already expressed per product reference unit.
Round the product to the order currency and then convert it into the company currency.
records.formula: amount_to_invoice_at_date = convert_quantity( qty_to_invoice_at_date , line_unit , product_reference_unit ) × gross_price_unit

rounding.what: The amount, after the multiplication.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the order currency, before the conversion into the company currency.
rounding.step: Once, on the order-currency amount, and then the converted company-currency amount is written.

result.name: amount still to bill as at the accrual date
result.unit_or_currency: the order currency, then converted to the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored on the order; it becomes the amount of the per-line item of the accrued-expense entry.

edge_cases.case: The quantity still to bill is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The amount is negative and the per-line accrual item is a credit rather than a debit.

edge_cases.case: The gross unit price is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The amount is zero and the line contributes nothing, though it may still have been selected.

edge_cases.case: The line unit is the product reference unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The conversion leaves the quantity unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The order currency differs from the company currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The amount is rounded in the order currency first and only then converted, so the company-currency figure carries the order-currency rounding.

worked_examples.description: Six boxes of twelve still to bill at 9.50 per unit
worked_examples.narrative: Six boxes are seventy-two units, and seventy-two multiplied by 9.50 is 684.00.

records.name: Choosing between restricted and stored quantities for an accrual date
records.purpose: Fixes when the received and billed quantities are recomputed over a restricted set of records and when the stored figures are used, so that an accrual at a past date and a computation for today do not diverge.

operands.name: accrual date supplied by the caller
operands.source: the accrued-expense assistant, or absent
operands.constraints: may be in the past, today or in the future

operands.name: today's date
operands.source: the current date of the system
operands.constraints: the boundary of the test

operands.name: stored received quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the received quantity field of the order line
operands.constraints: the figure computed over every completed movement

operands.name: stored billed quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the billed quantity field of the order line
operands.constraints: the figure computed over every linked bill line

preconditions.condition: The caller supplied a date.
preconditions.otherwise: The stored figures are used unchanged.

preconditions.condition: The supplied date is strictly in the past.
preconditions.otherwise: The stored figures are used unchanged, because a date that is today or in the future restricts nothing.

procedure: Compare the supplied accrual date with today's date.
When the date is strictly in the past, recompute the received quantity over the completed goods movements dated on or before it, and the billed quantity over the bill lines dated on or before it.
When the date is today, is in the future, or was not supplied at all, use the stored received and billed quantities unchanged.
Feed whichever pair results into the quantity still to bill and into the amount still to bill.
records.formula: ( qty_received_at_date , qty_invoiced_at_date ) = the restricted recomputation when accrual_date < today ; = ( qty_received , qty_invoiced ) when accrual_date ≥ today or no date was supplied

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; each recomputed quantity is rounded by the computation that produces it.
rounding.precision: The rounding of the line's unit of measure, applied by the received-quantity and billed-quantity computations.
rounding.step: Inside the two recomputations.

result.name: received and billed quantities as at the accrual date
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the at-date quantity and amount still to bill.

edge_cases.case: The date is exactly today.
edge_cases.outcome: The stored figures are used, because the test is strictly in the past.

edge_cases.case: Movements exist dated after the accrual date.
edge_cases.outcome: They are dropped from the recomputation, so the received quantity as at the date is lower than the stored figure.

edge_cases.case: Bill lines exist dated after the accrual date.
edge_cases.outcome: They are dropped, so the billed quantity as at the date is lower than the stored figure.

edge_cases.case: No movement and no bill line is dated on or before the accrual date.
edge_cases.outcome: Both restricted figures are zero and the line's quantity still to bill at the date is the ordered quantity under the ordered-quantities policy and zero under the received-quantities policy.

worked_examples.description: The same line judged at a past date and today
worked_examples.narrative: At the past date only six units had arrived, so the received quantity as at that date is six while the stored figure is ten; the billed quantity is four either way because every bill line predates the accrual date.

records.name: The unit price handed to a goods movement
records.purpose: Gives the value at which purchasing hands an incoming goods movement to inventory, which is what values the receipt before any bill exists.

operands.name: unit price of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the order currency per line unit
operands.source: the unit price field of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: discount percentage of the line
operands.source: the discount field of the order line
operands.constraints: from 0 to 100 in ordinary use

operands.name: taxes of the line
operands.source: the tax set of the order line
operands.constraints: may be empty; the vendor and the product are handed to the tax computation as well

operands.name: ordered quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the total quantity field of the order line
operands.constraints: when it is zero, a quantity of one is used in its place

operands.name: factor of the product reference unit and factor of the line unit
operands.source: the unit of measure records
operands.constraints: both strictly positive

operands.name: order currency, company currency, company of the order and conversion date
operands.source: the order, and the conversion date the caller supplies, failing that the order deadline, failing that today
operands.constraints: the date is reduced to its date part

operands.name: Product Price decimal precision
operands.source: the named decimal precision record for product prices
operands.constraints: 2 digits as shipped

preconditions.condition: The line has a product that is stored in inventory.
preconditions.otherwise: No goods movement is created and no unit price is needed.

preconditions.condition: The order has a currency and a company.
preconditions.otherwise: The company currency is substituted for a missing order currency, and the conversion cannot be made without a company.

procedure: Start from the line's discounted unit price.

When the line has taxes, let the quantity be the ordered quantity, or one when it is zero; compute the taxes on that price for that quantity, in the order currency, for this product and this vendor, with global rounding; take the amount that excludes every tax, including those that are not deductible; and divide it by that quantity.
When the line unit differs from the product reference unit, divide by the factor of the line unit and multiply by the factor of the product reference unit.

When the order currency differs from the company currency, convert into the company currency for the order's company at the conversion date the caller supplies, failing that the order deadline, failing that today, and do so without rounding.
Round the result to the Product Price decimal precision and hand it to the goods movement.
records.formula: move_price_unit = round_to_precision( convert_to_company_currency( ( total_excluding_every_tax( price_unit × ( 1 − discount ÷ 100 ) , taxes , q ) ÷ q ) × ( product_unit_factor ÷ line_unit_factor ) ) , product_price_digits )

rounding.what: The final value handed to the goods movement; the currency conversion before it is deliberately left unrounded.
rounding.precision: The Product Price decimal precision, 2 digits as shipped.
rounding.step: Once, at the very end, after the tax removal, the unit restatement and the currency conversion; the currency conversion itself is performed with rounding disabled.

result.name: unit price of the incoming goods movement
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the goods movement and used by inventory valuation to value the receipt when no bill exists.

edge_cases.case: A tax that is fully recoverable.
edge_cases.outcome: The amount excluding every tax equals the discounted price, so the movement price is unaffected.

edge_cases.case: A tax that is not recoverable.
edge_cases.outcome: It is included in the amount excluding every tax, so it raises the value at which the goods enter stock, exactly as it must.

edge_cases.case: A discount on the line.
edge_cases.outcome: It lowers the value at which the goods enter stock, because the discounted price is the starting point.

edge_cases.case: No conversion date is supplied.
edge_cases.outcome: The order deadline is used, so a later rate change does not retroactively alter the valuation of a movement that has not been re-valued.

edge_cases.case: The unit price of a confirmed line is changed.
edge_cases.outcome: The unit price of that line's open movements is rewritten, kit component movements excluded, and the line's already valued movements are re-valued.

edge_cases.case: The unit price is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The movement is valued at zero, and the whole standard cost becomes a price difference at billing time.

worked_examples.description: Ten boxes of twelve at 120.00 with a five per cent discount, a fully recoverable tax of twenty per cent, and an order rate of 1.25
worked_examples.narrative: The discounted price is 114.00 per box; the tax is fully recoverable so the amount excluding tax is still 114.00; per unit that is 114.00 divided by twelve, that is 9.50; converting into the company currency at a rate of 1.25 gives 9.50 divided by 1.25, that is 7.60; rounded to two digits it stays 7.60. Ten boxes therefore bring one hundred and twenty units into stock at 7.60 each, a valuation of 912.00 in the company currency.

records.name: The values prepared for a bill line from an order line
records.purpose: Fixes the quantity, unit price and discount a bill line receives when it is prepared from a purchase order line, so that the generated bill reproduces the order's arithmetic.

operands.name: quantity still to bill of the order line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the order line
operands.source: the computed quantity to bill
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative; negated when the target document has already been forced to a refund

operands.name: unit price of the order line
operands.unit_or_currency: the order currency per line unit
operands.source: the unit price field of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: discount percentage of the order line
operands.source: the discount field of the order line
operands.constraints: copied unchanged

operands.name: order currency and bill currency
operands.source: the order and the document being prepared
operands.constraints: normally the same, because the bill inherits the order currency

operands.name: company of the order line
operands.source: the company field of the order line
operands.constraints: always equals the order's company

operands.name: date of the bill
operands.source: the bill's date, failing that today
operands.constraints: used as the conversion date

preconditions.condition: The order line is not a display line.
preconditions.otherwise: A display line is copied as a display line and carries no quantity, price or discount.

preconditions.condition: The order line has something to bill.
preconditions.otherwise: The line is still prepared when the caller asks for the whole order, but its quantity is zero and it appears on the bill with quantity zero.

procedure: Take the order line's quantity still to bill as the bill line's quantity, negating it when the caller has already forced the target document to be a refund.
Convert the order line's unit price from the order currency into the bill currency, for the line's company, at the bill's date or today, and do so without rounding.
Copy the order line's discount percentage unchanged.

Copy the product, the unit, the taxes, the down-payment flag and the link back to the order line, and leave the account to the ordinary defaulting rules except on a down-payment line that already has bill lines, whose account is reused from the first of them.
records.formula: bill_line.quantity = qty_to_invoice , negated when the target document is a refund ; bill_line.price_unit = convert( line.price_unit , from = order_currency , to = bill_currency , company = line_company , date = bill_date or today , round = false ) ; bill_line.discount = line.discount

rounding.what: Nothing here: the unit price is converted with rounding disabled.
rounding.precision: Not applicable at this step; the bill's own rounding is applied later, once, when its amounts are computed.
rounding.step: Deliberately none, so that the bill applies its rounding a single time rather than inheriting a rounding from the preparation.

result.name: prepared bill line values
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the order line's unit and amounts in the bill currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Written onto the new bill line of the generated vendor bill or refund.

edge_cases.case: The bill currency equals the order currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The conversion is a no-op and the unit price is copied unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The quantity still to bill is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The prepared document's total is negative and the document is switched to a vendor refund after creation, which flips the sign of every amount.

edge_cases.case: The prepared document's total is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: It stays a vendor bill; the switch fires only on a strictly negative rounded total.

edge_cases.case: An order with only sections and no product line.
edge_cases.outcome: The line walk never flushes the pending section, so the bill has no lines at all.

edge_cases.case: Several orders are billed together.
edge_cases.outcome: They are grouped by company, vendor and currency, one bill per group, and the source document lists every order of the group.

worked_examples.description: A line with four still to bill at 60.00, billed in the order currency
worked_examples.narrative: The quantity is four, the unit price is converted at a rate of one and stays 60.00 with no rounding applied, and the discount of zero is copied unchanged.

records.name: The company-currency balance of a prepared bill line
records.purpose: Gives the company-currency figure a prepared bill line carries when inventory is installed, computed with every rounding disabled so that the bill rounds once and only once.

operands.name: unit price of the order line
operands.unit_or_currency: the order currency per line unit
operands.source: the unit price field of the order line
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: discount percentage of the order line
operands.source: the discount field of the order line
operands.constraints: from 0 to 100 in ordinary use

operands.name: taxes of the order line
operands.source: the tax set of the order line
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: quantity still to bill
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the order line
operands.source: the computed quantity to bill
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: company currency
operands.source: the company of the order line
operands.constraints: the target of the conversion

preconditions.condition: Inventory is installed.
preconditions.otherwise: No balance is prepared and the bill computes its own from the unit price and the quantity.

preconditions.condition: No balance was supplied by the caller.
preconditions.otherwise: The supplied balance is kept and this computation is skipped.

procedure: Take the discounted unit price of the order line.
Ask the tax engine for the amount excluding tax at that price for the quantity still to bill, with rounding disabled at both the tax level and the base level.
Convert that amount into the company currency, again without rounding.
Write the result as the bill line's company-currency balance, leaving the bill's own rounding to be applied once, later.
records.formula: bill_line.balance = convert_to_company_currency( total_excluding_tax( price_unit × ( 1 − discount ÷ 100 ) , taxes , qty_to_invoice ) , round = false ) , with the tax computation itself rounded neither at the tax level nor at the base level

rounding.what: Nothing at this step, deliberately.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; both the tax rounding and the base rounding are disabled and the currency conversion is unrounded.
rounding.step: None here; the bill applies its own rounding once, later, when it computes its amounts.

result.name: company-currency balance of the prepared bill line
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Written onto the prepared bill line and used by the bill when it computes its journal items.

edge_cases.case: Inventory is not installed.
edge_cases.outcome: No balance is prepared at all.

edge_cases.case: A balance was supplied by the caller.
edge_cases.outcome: It is kept and this computation is skipped.

edge_cases.case: The quantity still to bill is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance is negative and the document becomes a vendor refund.

edge_cases.case: Rounding were applied here as well as on the bill.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure could differ in the last digit from the bill's own computation; disabling the rounding here is what prevents that divergence.

worked_examples.description: Four units at 60.00 with no discount and a tax that is not included
worked_examples.narrative: The discounted price is 60.00, the amount excluding tax for four units is 240.00 computed with rounding disabled, and the conversion into the company currency at a rate of one leaves 240.00.

records.name: The vendor's on-time delivery rate
records.purpose: Gives the percentage of ordered quantity a vendor delivered by the expected arrival over a lookback window, which is shown on the vendor record and used to compare vendors.

operands.name: lookback window in days
operands.source: the system parameter `purchase_stock.on_time_delivery_days`, the purchase-stock on-time-delivery-days parameter, defaulting to 365
operands.constraints: a whole number of days, strictly positive

operands.name: total quantity of each qualifying order line
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of the product
operands.source: the order lines of the vendor within the window
operands.constraints: the denominator sums these line quantities

operands.name: quantity of each completed goods movement of those lines
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of the product
operands.source: the completed movements of the qualifying lines
operands.constraints: the numerator sums these movement quantities

operands.name: expected arrival of each qualifying line
operands.source: the order line
operands.constraints: compared by date part only

operands.name: date of each completed movement
operands.source: the goods movement
operands.constraints: compared by date part only

preconditions.condition: At least one qualifying line exists for the vendor.
preconditions.otherwise: The rate is minus one, which is the sentinel for no data and is what the interface tests before showing a percentage.

preconditions.condition: The lookback parameter is readable.
preconditions.otherwise: The default of 365 days applies.

procedure: Select the purchase order lines whose partner is the vendor, whose order date is later than today minus the lookback window, whose received quantity is not zero, whose order is in the confirmed status, and whose product is not a service.
Select the completed goods movements of those lines.
Keep the movements whose date part is on or before the date part of their line's expected arrival, and sum their quantities per line into the on-time quantity of that line.
Sum the total quantities of the selected lines into the ordered quantity of the vendor, and the on-time quantities into the on-time quantity of the vendor.
Divide the on-time quantity by the ordered quantity and multiply by one hundred; return minus one instead when the ordered quantity is zero.
records.formula: ordered( vendor ) = Σ over the selected lines of line.total_quantity ; on_time( vendor ) = Σ over the selected lines of on_time( line ) ; on_time_rate = on_time( vendor ) ÷ ordered( vendor ) × 100 when ordered( vendor ) ≠ 0 , and = −1 otherwise

rounding.what: The rate as it is displayed.
rounding.precision: Two decimal digits as displayed on the vendor record.
rounding.step: At display; the ratio itself is kept at full precision.

result.name: on-time delivery rate of the vendor
result.unit_or_currency: a percentage, or minus one as the no-data sentinel
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the vendor record and shown as a percentage, except when it is minus one, which the interface tests for and hides.

edge_cases.case: The vendor has no qualifying line.
edge_cases.outcome: The rate is minus one and no percentage is shown.

edge_cases.case: A line is over-delivered.
edge_cases.outcome: The numerator sums movement quantities while the denominator sums line total quantities, so an over-delivery can push the rate above one hundred per cent.

edge_cases.case: A movement arrives on the same calendar day as the expected arrival but later in the day.
edge_cases.outcome: It still counts as on time, because only the date parts are compared.

edge_cases.case: The product of a line is a service.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is excluded, because a service has no goods movement to be punctual about.

edge_cases.case: A line's received quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is excluded from both the numerator and the denominator.

worked_examples.description: Three qualifying lines over the window
worked_examples.narrative: The ordered quantity is one hundred plus fifty plus twenty-five, that is one hundred and seventy-five; the on-time quantity is one hundred plus fifty, that is one hundred and fifty; and one hundred and fifty divided by one hundred and seventy-five multiplied by one hundred is 85.71 per cent.

records.name: The on-time quantity of a purchase order line in the vendor delay report
records.purpose: Gives, per order line, the total quantity ordered and the quantity that arrived by the expected arrival, which are the two columns the vendor delay report aggregates.

operands.name: total quantity of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.source: the total quantity field of the order line
operands.constraints: the denominator column of the report

operands.name: quantity of each movement detail
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the movement detail
operands.source: the details of the completed goods movements of the line
